an7.67:1.1: yato kho bhikkhave rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ sattahi nagaraparikkhārehi suparikkhataṃ hoti catunnañca āhārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī
an7.67:1.2: idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ akaraṇīyaṃ bāhirehi paccatthikehi paccāmittehi
an7.67:2.2: idha bhikkhave rañño paccantime nagare esikā hoti gambhīranemā sunikhātā acalā asampavedhī
an7.67:2.3: iminā paṭhamena nagaraparikkhārena suparikkhataṃ hoti rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ abbhantarānaṃ guttiyā bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya.
an7.67:3.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave rañño paccantime nagare parikkhā hoti gambhīrā ceva vitthatā ca
an7.67:3.2: iminā dutiyena nagaraparikkhārena suparikkhataṃ hoti rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ abbhantarānaṃ guttiyā bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya.
an7.67:4.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave rañño paccantime nagare anupariyāyapatho hoti ucco ceva vitthato ca
an7.67:4.2: iminā tatiyena nagaraparikkhārena suparikkhataṃ hoti rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ abbhantarānaṃ guttiyā bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya.
an7.67:5.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave rañño paccantime nagare bahuṃ āvudhaṃ sannicitaṃ hoti salākañceva jevanikañca
an7.67:5.2: iminā catutthena nagaraparikkhārena suparikkhataṃ hoti rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ abbhantarānaṃ guttiyā bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya.
an7.67:6.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave rañño paccantime nagare bahu balakāyo paṭivasati seyyathīdaṃ
an7.67:6.2: hatthārohā assārohā rathikā dhanuggahā celakā calakā piṇḍadāyakā uggā rājaputtā pakkhandino mahānāgā sūrā papphālikā cammayodhino dāsakaputtā
an7.67:6.3: iminā pañcamena nagaraparikkhārena suparikkhataṃ hoti rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ abbhantarānaṃ guttiyā bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya.
an7.67:7.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave rañño paccantime nagare dovāriko hoti paṇḍito byatto medhāvī aññātānaṃ nivāretā ñātānaṃ pavesetā
an7.67:7.2: iminā chaṭṭhena nagaraparikkhārena suparikkhataṃ hoti rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ abbhantarānaṃ guttiyā bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya.
an7.67:8.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave rañño paccantime nagare pākāro hoti ucco ceva vitthato ca vāsanalepanasampanno ca
an7.67:8.2: iminā sattamena nagaraparikkhārena suparikkhataṃ hoti rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ abbhantarānaṃ guttiyā bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya.
an7.67:9.1: katamesaṃ catunnaṃ āhārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī
an7.67:9.2: idha bhikkhave rañño paccantime nagare bahu tiṇakaṭṭhodakaṃ sannicitaṃ hoti abbhantarānaṃ ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya.
an7.67:10.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave rañño paccantime nagare bahuṃ sāliyavakaṃ sannicitaṃ hoti abbhantarānaṃ ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya.
an7.67:11.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave rañño paccantime nagare bahuṃ tilamuggamāsāparaṇṇaṃ sannicitaṃ hoti abbhantarānaṃ ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya.
an7.67:12.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave rañño paccantime nagare bahuṃ bhesajjaṃ sannicitaṃ hoti seyyathīdaṃ
an7.67:12.2: sappi navanītaṃ telaṃ madhu phāṇitaṃ loṇaṃ abbhantarānaṃ ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya.
an7.67:12.3: imesaṃ catunnaṃ āhārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī
an7.67:13.1: yato kho bhikkhave rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ sattahi nagaraparikkhārehi suparikkhataṃ hoti catunnañca āhārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī
an7.67:13.2: idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ akaraṇīyaṃ bāhirehi paccatthikehi paccāmittehi.
an7.67:13.3: evameva kho bhikkhave yato ariyasāvako sattahi saddhammehi samannāgato hoti catunnañca jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī
an7.67:13.4: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave ariyasāvako akaraṇīyo mārassa akaraṇīyo pāpimato.
an7.67:14.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave rañño paccantime nagare esikā hoti gambhīranemā sunikhātā acalā asampavedhi abbhantarānaṃ guttiyā bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya
an7.67:14.2: evameva kho bhikkhave ariyasāvako saddho hoti saddahati tathāgatassa bodhiṃ
an7.67:14.4: saddhāsiko bhikkhave ariyasāvako akusalaṃ pajahati kusalaṃ bhāveti
an7.67:15.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave rañño paccantime nagare parikkhā hoti gambhīrā ceva vitthatā ca abbhantarānaṃ guttiyā bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya
an7.67:15.2: evameva kho bhikkhave ariyasāvako hirīmā hoti hiriyati kāyaduccaritena vacīduccaritena manoduccaritena hiriyati pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā
an7.67:15.3: hirīparikkho bhikkhave ariyasāvako akusalaṃ pajahati kusalaṃ bhāveti
an7.67:16.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave rañño paccantime nagare anupariyāyapatho hoti ucco ceva vitthato ca abbhantarānaṃ guttiyā bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya
an7.67:16.2: evameva kho bhikkhave ariyasāvako ottappī hoti ottappati kāyaduccaritena vacīduccaritena manoduccaritena ottappati pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā
an7.67:16.3: ottappapariyāyapatho bhikkhave ariyasāvako akusalaṃ pajahati kusalaṃ bhāveti
an7.67:17.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave rañño paccantime nagare bahuṃ āvudhaṃ sannicitaṃ hoti salākañceva jevanikañca abbhantarānaṃ guttiyā bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya
an7.67:17.2: evameva kho bhikkhave ariyasāvako bahussuto hoti …pe… diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā
an7.67:17.3: sutāvudho bhikkhave ariyasāvako akusalaṃ pajahati kusalaṃ bhāveti
an7.67:18.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave rañño paccantime nagare bahu balakāyo paṭivasati seyyathīdaṃ
an7.67:18.2: hatthārohā assārohā rathikā dhanuggahā celakā calakā piṇḍadāyakā uggā rājaputtā pakkhandino mahānāgā sūrā papphālikā cammayodhino dāsakaputtā abbhantarānaṃ guttiyā bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya
an7.67:18.3: evameva kho bhikkhave ariyasāvako āraddhaviriyo viharati akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadāya thāmavā daḷhaparakkamo anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu
an7.67:18.4: viriyabalakāyo bhikkhave ariyasāvako akusalaṃ pajahati kusalaṃ bhāveti
an7.67:19.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave rañño paccantime nagare dovāriko hoti paṇḍito byatto medhāvī aññātānaṃ nivāretā ñātānaṃ pavesetā abbhantarānaṃ guttiyā bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya
an7.67:19.2: evameva kho bhikkhave ariyasāvako satimā hoti paramena satinepakkena samannāgato cirakatampi cirabhāsitampi saritā anussaritā
an7.67:19.3: satidovāriko bhikkhave ariyasāvako akusalaṃ pajahati kusalaṃ bhāveti
an7.67:20.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave rañño paccantime nagare pākāro hoti ucco ceva vitthato ca vāsanalepanasampanno ca abbhantarānaṃ guttiyā bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya
an7.67:20.2: evameva kho bhikkhave ariyasāvako paññavā hoti udayatthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya sammādukkhakkhayagāminiyā
an7.67:20.3: paññāvāsanalepanasampanno bhikkhave ariyasāvako akusalaṃ pajahati kusalaṃ bhāveti
an7.67:21.1: katamesaṃ catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī
an7.67:21.2: seyyathāpi bhikkhave rañño paccantime nagare bahuṃ tiṇakaṭṭhodakaṃ sannicitaṃ hoti abbhantarānaṃ ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya
an7.67:21.3: evameva kho bhikkhave ariyasāvako vivicceva kāmehi …pe… paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
an7.67:21.4: attano ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya okkamanāya nibbānassa.
an7.67:22.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave rañño paccantime nagare bahuṃ sāliyavakaṃ sannicitaṃ hoti abbhantarānaṃ ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya
an7.67:22.2: evameva kho bhikkhave ariyasāvako vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā …pe… dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
an7.67:22.3: attano ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya okkamanāya nibbānassa.
an7.67:23.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave rañño paccantime nagare bahuṃ tilamuggamāsāparaṇṇaṃ sannicitaṃ hoti abbhantarānaṃ ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya
an7.67:23.2: evameva kho bhikkhave ariyasāvako pītiyā ca virāgā …pe… tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
an7.67:23.3: attano ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya okkamanāya nibbānassa.
an7.67:24.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave rañño paccantime nagare bahuṃ bhesajjaṃ sannicitaṃ hoti seyyathīdaṃ
an7.67:24.2: sappi navanītaṃ telaṃ madhu phāṇitaṃ loṇaṃ abbhantarānaṃ ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya
an7.67:24.3: evameva kho bhikkhave ariyasāvako sukhassa ca pahānā …pe… catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
an7.67:24.4: attano ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya okkamanāya nibbānassa.
an7.67:24.5: imesaṃ catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī
an7.67:25.1: yato kho bhikkhave ariyasāvako imehi sattahi saddhammehi samannāgato hoti imesañca catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī
an7.67:25.2: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave ariyasāvako akaraṇīyo mārassa akaraṇīyo pāpimatoti.
